name: Tanetomo
source: One of the members of the Hakkenshi who is affiliated with the Warmongers. A tactician by trade, Tanetomo is a wise officer who is in charge of making sure that their Guild functions properly. Prideful, soft-spoken, and sophisticated, he becomes incredibly jealous if the spotlight of the stage moves away from him to someone else.
